cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess
CAND=['python3','submission/ipv6_replay.py']
r = subprocess.run(CAND+['plan','examples/manifest.json'],capture_output=True)
p = json.loads(r.stdout)
assert set(p) == {'version','probes'}, set(p)
for pr in p['probes']:
    assert set(pr) == {'id','window','scope','subnet','target','role','slot','attempt','sent_ms','deadline_ms'}, set(pr)
    assert isinstance(pr['subnet'], int) and isinstance(pr['slot'], int) and isinstance(pr['attempt'], int)
    assert pr['role'] in ('low','canary')
    assert pr['deadline_ms'] - pr['sent_ms'] == 100
r = subprocess.run(CAND+['replay','examples/manifest.json','examples/responses.jsonl'],capture_output=True)
d = json.loads(r.stdout)
assert set(d) == {'version','accepted_rows','duplicate_rows','diagnostics','segments'}, set(d)
for s in d['segments']:
    assert set(s) == {'window','scope','subnet','network','state','exposure','canary_hits','internal','external','overlap','targets'}, set(s)
    assert s['state'] in ('alias_suspect','ambiguous','usable')
    assert s['exposure'] in ('excluded','observed_internal_reply','inconclusive')
    assert s['network'].endswith('/64')
    for t in s['targets']:
        assert set(t) == {'address','classification','internal_attempts','external_attempts','external_sources','silent_attempts'}, set(t)
        assert t['classification'] in ('alias_suspect','ambiguous','mixed','internal','external','unknown')
for dg in d['diagnostics']:
    assert set(dg) == {'line','reason'}, set(dg)
    assert dg['reason'] in ('json','schema','address','unknown_probe','target_mismatch','time','icmp')
print('structure ok')
EOF
